                            CITY OF NORWALK 
                              CITY COUNCIL 
          REGULAR MEETING MINUTES - OCTOBER 27, 2026 
                  COUNCIL CHAMBERS AND VIA ZOOM 
                                        
 

ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Barbara C. Smyth, Joshua Goldstein, Council 
                  President; Nicol Ayers; Brian Bailey; Jesse Buccolo; Jan 
                  Degenshein; Richard Dellinger; Nicolé Eaddy; James 
                  Frayer; Colin Hosten; Johan Lopez; Broderick Sawyer; 
                  Jalin T. Sead Sr., Majority Leader; Anne Wennerstrand; 
                  Darlene Young 

STAFF:           Robert Stowers, Recreation & Parks; Ken Hughes, 
                  Recreation & Parks 

CALL TO ORDER 
Mayor Smyth called the meeting to order at 7:30 p.m. and led the Pledge of 
Allegiance. A roll call was taken and a quorum was present. 

ACCEPTANCE OF MINUTES – Regular Meeting: October 13, 2026 
No corrections were requested. 

**    MR. DEGENSHEIN MOVED TO ACCEPT THE MINUTES.  
**    MOTION PASSED 13-0-1. IN FAVOR: BAILEY, BUCCOLO, 
      DEGENSHEIN, DELLINGER, EADDY, FRAYER, GOLDSTEIN, 
      HOSTEN, LOPEZ, SAWYER, SEAD, WENNERSTRAND, YOUNG. 
      OPPOSED: NONE. ABSTAINED: AYERS. 

PUBLIC PARTICIPATION 
There were no speakers. Public participation was closed. 

MAYOR 
Resignations and Appointments: None. 
Mayor’s Remarks: Mayor Smyth made announcements regarding upcoming 
City events, early voting and Election Day, and the Veterans Day City Hall 
closure and ceremony. 

COUNCIL PRESIDENT 
Consent Calendar: Council Member Hosten read the Consent Calendar into 
the record, consisting of agenda items VII.A.2, VII.A.3, VII.A.4, 
VII.B.1(a)(b), VII.B.2(a)(b), VII.B.3(a)(b), VII.B.4(a)(b), and VII.B.5(a)(b).

Page 1 **    MOTION TO APPROVE THE CONSENT CALENDAR AS READ MADE 
      BY COUNCIL PRESIDENT GOLDSTEIN.  
**    MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY, 14-0. 

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEES 
Recreation, Parks and Cultural Affairs 
VII.A.1. Authorize the purchasing agent to issue a non-competitive 
procurement purchase to Spring City, for 41 LED city standard light fixtures 
for Calf Pasture Beach, in an amount not to exceed $237,636, from account 
09276030 5777 C0365. 
Council Member Young read the item into the record. Mr. Stowers and Mr. 
Hughes presented the item, and discussion followed regarding the sole-
source justification, pricing, and scope of the purchase. 

**    MS. YOUNG MOVED THE ITEM.  
**    MOTION PASSED 13-1. IN FAVOR: AYERS, BAILEY, BUCCOLO, 
      DEGENSHEIN, EADDY, FRAYER, GOLDSTEIN, HOSTEN, LOPEZ, 
      SAWYER, SEAD, WENNERSTRAND, YOUNG. OPPOSED: 
      DELLINGER. 

ADJOURNMENT 
**    MOTION TO ADJOURN MADE BY MR. DEGENSHEIN.   
**    MOTION PASSED UNANIMOUSLY. 

The meeting adjourned at 8:04 p.m. 

Respectfully Submitted, 
Courtney Baldwin 
Recording Secretary
